reviews.title: Crazy CarPlay!
reviews.text: I use the system primarily for Google directions and to listen to audio books, and it was great initially. But in the past few months it randomly starts calling people on my favorites list, usually when an audio book is playing. I have to quickly end the call but then it goes on to the next person. Some lucky folks might get five calls from me in a short period of time. I can’t end the calls on my dashboard, only on my phone, which isn’t always safe. A visit to the dealership is in my future.
